title: Neutralisation and pH
goal: Add a base to an acid. Predict whether the mix ends up acidic, neutral or basic.
intro: This flask holds 25 mL of watered-down hydrochloric acid. A few drops of universal indicator change colour to show the pH. Choose how much sodium hydroxide, a base, to add. Then make your guess.

prediction.question: After you add the base, the liquid in the flask will be…

safety: Wear goggles. Even watered-down acid and sodium hydroxide can hurt your eyes. Rinse any splash with lots of water.
